preconditions.description: The grid must have dimensions between 1x1 and 100x100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid must be square, i.e., all rows must have the same length as the number of rows.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in [0, 1] for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must contain either 0 (water) or 1 (land).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if all(cell == 0 for row in grid for cell in row) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no land cells, return -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if all(cell == 1 for row in grid for cell in row) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no water cells, return -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(max(abs(i - x) + abs(j - y) for x in range(len(grid)) for y in range(len(grid)) if grid[x][y] == 1) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid)) if grid[i][j] == 0)
postconditions.description: The returned distance is the maximum Manhattan distance from any water cell to the nearest land cell.
